"""Commit compact layer-major qualification and retire closed duplicate logs."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W = G / 'feat-restore-layer-major-prefill-20261013'
K = G / 'feat-phase-gated-quality-capture-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-restored-layer-major-lifecycle'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('layer_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    names = [
        'main-layer-major-full-build-root-v1', 'main-layer-major-full-build-root-v2',
        'main-layer-major-full-build-root-v3', 'main-layer-major-full-lints-root-v1',
        'main-layer-major-full-lints-root-v2', 'main-layer-major-model-lifetime-root-v1',
        'main-layer-major-model-lifetime-root-v2']
    receipts = {name: load(B / name / 'record.json') for name in names}
    assert all(not d['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in d['commands']) for d in receipts.values())
    build = receipts['main-layer-major-full-build-root-v3']
    lint = receipts['main-layer-major-full-lints-root-v2']
    actual = receipts['main-layer-major-model-lifetime-root-v2']
    assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] for d in (build, lint, actual))
    assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
    assert build['source_pins'] == lint['source_pins'] == actual['source_pins']
    assert actual['binary_sha256'] == build['free']['binary_sha256']
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             source_pins=build['source_pins'], gpu_executed=False, adopted=False, performance_samples=[])

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(build['environment'], GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('LAYER PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        dirty = run('dirty', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        new = run('new', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        assert set(dirty + new) == set(build['source_pins'])
        F.mkdir()
        compact_paths = {}
        deletion_candidates = []
        for name, original in receipts.items():
            path = B / name / 'record.json'
            compact = {k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            compact['evidence_policy'] = 'Full successful text/source listings retired after verified structured results; command/log identity, ownership, findings and original failure status retained.'
            compact['original_receipt'] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                consumer='Current phase qualification controllers pin these immutable receipts; retire original only after consumers move to compact evidence')
            if name.endswith('build-root-v1'):
                evidence = original['evidence'].get('build-free', {})
                compact['failure_excerpt'] = '\n'.join(line for line in (evidence.get('stdout', '') + '\n' + evidence.get('stderr', '')).splitlines()
                    if re.search(r'error:|sign-compare|1453|Werror|ninja: build stopped', line))[:8192]
            if name.endswith('model-lifetime-root-v2'):
                compact['health_outputs'] = {label: '\n'.join(line for line in original['evidence'][label]['stdout'].splitlines()
                    if line.startswith(('PASS ', 'LIBRARY '))) for label in ('health-before', 'health-after')}
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, compact)
            assert load(target)['passed'] == original['passed'] and load(target)['complete'] == original['complete']
            compact_paths[name] = target
            for command in original['commands']:
                for log_name, identity in command['logs'].items():
                    raw = B / name / 'commands' / log_name
                    if raw.is_file():
                        assert raw.stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == identity['sha256']
                        deletion_candidates.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=identity['bytes'], sha256=identity['sha256'],
                            replacement=str(target), replacement_sha256=m.sha(target), reason='Closed duplicate raw text; command status/identity, relevant findings, exact requests/admissions/layer rows and health/fault outcomes retained'))
        controllers = ['main-layer-major-full-build-v1.py', 'main-layer-major-full-build-v2.py',
                       'main-layer-major-full-build-v3.py', 'main-layer-major-full-lints-v1.py',
                       'main-layer-major-full-lints-v2.py', 'main-layer-major-model-lifetime-v1.py',
                       'main-layer-major-model-lifetime-v2.py']
        for name in controllers:
            path = B / name
            dump(F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'), dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))
        report_names = [
            'implementation-bounded-decode-route-ledger-v3.txt',
            'research-restored-layer-cache-safety-round402-v1.txt',
            'research-serve-decode-profile-coverage-round403-v1.txt',
            'research-serve-decode-profile-coverage-round403-v2.txt',
            'implementation-layer-major-phase-cycle-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-bridge-dma-contract-round404-v1.txt',
            'research-phase-full-lease-safety-round405-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-major-numeric-capture-round406-v1.txt',
            'implementation-layer-major-full-context-probe-v1.txt']
        reports = []
        for name in report_names:
            path = B / 'research-20261009' / name
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text(),
                qualification='Source-only research/implementation; executed Main results are separate'))
            reports.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior_path = K / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-gated-quality-capture/report-registry-v194.json'
        prior = load(prior_path)
        assert prior['research_completed'] == 958
        registry = dict(research_completed=958 + len(reports), prior=dict(path=str(prior_path),
            git_revision='b4f7b5ec1d7583de52f0e0dbcf181d461591cf17', sha256=m.sha(prior_path)),
            new_reports=reports, main_only_test_execution=True,
            main_corrections='R402 source hashes precede Main layout/literal fix. R403 corrects Main missed existing serve profile hook: device stamps are uncalibrated ticks and prof_on disables eligible mixer side branch, so fractions do not prove quiet critical path. R404 6.4468 GB/s is Host-USM H2D; pageable control is4.6052 GB/s, neither measures this bridge. Actual L phase0 lifecycle passed, no quality/256K/speed proof. P phase lease and typed decode ledger remain pending separate source candidates.')
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v195.json', registry)
        summary = dict(source_revision=actual['source_revision'], source_pins=actual['source_pins'],
            binary_sha256=actual['binary_sha256'], build_modes=['free', 'contrib-llvm'], full_builds_pass=True,
            host_ctest_four_configurations_pass=True, host_asan_ubsan_pass=True, server_phase_lifetime_pass=True,
            actual_parent_no_new_lints_pass=True, actual_device_phase0_lifecycle_pass=True,
            exact_requests=actual['requests'], admissions=actual['actual_admissions'], layer_rows=actual['actual_layer_rows'],
            normal_quit=actual['normal_quit'], boot_id=actual['boot_id'], kernel_cursor=actual['kernel_cursor'],
            kernel_checks=actual['kernel_checks'], preserved_failures=['WERROR signedness', 'two new static findings', 'controller reserve-option preflight'],
            model_quality_qualified=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,
            stock_benchmark_executed=False, performance_samples=[], adopted=False,
            next_step='Qualify actual full cache/head lease tiny VMM then paired numerical and full context boundaries; matched speed only unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3',
            skill_scope=dict(project='/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl', installed_path='/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync',
                canonical_skill_revision='97f8b40ca99ec298c24d7ecc7b270e530d43194d', user_global_paths_absent=True,
                dependency='Keep canonical skill worktree while project discovery symlink targets it'), research_completed=registry['research_completed'])
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        dump(F / 'deletion-manifest.json', dict(policy='docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md in user workspace',
            serialized=True, active_runs_touched=False, original_failed_status_preserved=True,
            original_pinned_receipts_retained_for_current_consumers=True, entries=deletion_candidates,
            logical_bytes=sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates), physical_free_space_claim=False))
        ja = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->
# レイヤー単位prefill復元候補の実機検証

1Kと32Kのfresh GENを同一プロセスで完了し、通常のQUITで終了した。
48層ごとに全512 expertを一度読み込み、32Kでは4チャンクを処理した。
実行前後の16384ワードGPU検証、カーネル障害検査、12モデル入力の全SHA検査は通過した。

候補はphase0、FP32中間表現の全RAM配置、8Kチャンク、context262144、int8 KVのresident32768、明示700 MiB reserve。
各入力はmax_new1、raw spec4、実効T1、reuseなし。実際のprefillは入力の最後の1 tokenを除く1023/32767行。
32KのRAM中間表現は1342136320 bytes、レイヤーcacheは1363148800 bytes。
容量は実行中のfresh freeから検査し、通常device miss ringを省略した。
終了値や診断時間はsummaryに個別保存した。速度比較のサンプルではない。

free/contrib-llvmのビルド、4構成のCPU CTest、ASan/UBSan、サーバーphase lifetime、実際の親との静的検査を通過。
最初の符号比較ビルド失敗、2件の新規静的指摘、reserve引数確認のcontroller失敗は失敗のまま保存した。
Mainが型、Impl状態の冗長bool、乗算前の型拡張、明示reserveのcontrollerを修正した。
検査の無効化やreserve削減は行っていない。

数値品質、256K全領域、RESTORE、bench.shによる速度比較、正式採用は未成立。
同じ出力IDは品質比較の代わりにならない。既存serve profileは有効時にmixer side branchを抑止するため、静かな実行のcritical pathをその比率から断定できない。
約6.45 GB/sはHost-USM H2Dの既存測定で、pageable H2Dの既存値は約4.61 GB/s。今回のbridge帯域の実測ではない。

別作業ツリーのdecode cache/head全解放案と、型付きdecode route ledgerはまだsource候補。
Mainは全物理leaseを2層・2回検査する小さな実機fixtureを追加し、ビルドを進めている。
次はそのlease検証、固定履歴の数値比較、256K境界、上流の変更しないbench.sh --long --runs 3。

調査台帳v195は過去958件と新規9件を参照する。
成功ログと親ソース表示の重複は検証済み構造化結果に集約して削除し、path/hash/reasonをmanifestに残す。
現在のcontrollerがhashで参照する元のreceiptは変更せず保持する。物理ストレージ解放量は主張しない。
スキルの検出リンクはこのプロジェクトの.agents/skillsだけにあり、ユーザー共通の2か所には存在しない。
'''
        en = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->
# Restored layer-major prefill candidate qualification

Fresh 1K and32K GEN requests completed in one process followed by normal QUIT.
All512 experts were uploaded once per each of48 layers;32K processed four chunks.
Pre/post16384-word GPU checks, kernel fault checks and full SHA checks of12 model inputs passed.

The candidate used phase0, all-RAM FP32 residuals,8K chunks, configured context262144, int8 KV resident32768 and explicit700 MiB reserve.
Each request used max_new1, raw spec4, effectiveT1 and no reuse. Actual prefill processed1023/32767 rows, excluding the final conditioning position.
The32K residual allocation was1342136320 bytes and the layer cache1363148800 bytes.
Admission used fresh reported free memory; the normal device miss ring was omitted.
Individual completion records and diagnostic times are in summary. They are not speed samples.

Free/contrib-llvm builds, four CPU CTest configurations, ASan/UBSan, server phase lifetime and actual-parent static checks passed.
The initial signedness build failure, two new static findings and reserve-option controller preflight failure retain their failed status.
Main corrected the type, redundant Impl boolean, widening before multiplication and explicit reserve option.
No checks were disabled and the reserve was not reduced.

Numerical quality, full physical256K, RESTORE, bench.sh speed comparisons and adoption remain unqualified.
Matching output IDs do not replace a quality comparison. The existing serve profiler suppresses the eligible mixer side branch, so its fractions cannot establish the quiet execution critical path.
The prior6.45 GB/s sample used Host-USM H2D; the pageable H2D control attained about4.61 GB/s. Neither directly measures this bridge.

Separate full decode-cache/head lease and typed decode route ledger worktrees remain source candidates.
Main added a two-layer/two-cycle actual-device full lease fixture and is qualifying its builds.
Next: actual lease, fixed-history numerical comparison,256K boundaries and unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3.

Registryv195 references958 previous and9 new reports.
Verified structured evidence replaces duplicate successful text/source listings; a manifest records path/hash/reason.
Original hash-pinned receipts stay unchanged for current controllers. No physical storage gain is claimed.
The skill discovery link exists only under this project's.agents/skills; both user-wide paths are absent.
'''
        (F / 'README.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'README.md').write_text(en)
        dump(F / 'controllers/main-layer-major-publication-v1.py.json', dict(path=__file__, sha256=m.sha(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        files = sorted(str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in F.rglob('*') if path.is_file())
        output = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in output and '== gitleaks: a possible secret' not in output
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            raw = Path(entry['path'])
            assert raw.stat().st_size == entry['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == entry['sha256']
            assert m.sha(entry['replacement']) == entry['replacement_sha256']
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            Path(entry['path']).unlink()
        r['deleted_files'] = len(deletion_candidates)
        r['deleted_logical_bytes'] = sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Restore guarded layer-major prefill and record actual 32K lifecycle'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_completed=registry['research_completed'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'deleted_files', 'deleted_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
